description: Fuselage only. Shipped by sea from the United States in 1999; because bridges on the roads from Acajutla and from Guatemala could not take the trailer and its load; it was landed in Costa Rica instead and hauled overland to El Salvador. On display beside the Tin Marín children's museum since 28 October 1999. It never actually flew for TACA; although it wore TACA livery for years; it currently wears AVIANCA livery. Identity unknown — no registration; c/n or line number has been published; and the tail number is left blank rather than guessed. IMPORTANT: the source states it was "built in 1960 in Seattle"; which cannot be correct — the Boeing 727 first flew in February 1963 — so no year_built is recorded here.
